facts.fact: 候选群像（Chloe 之后）：Angela（Des Moines——自认与 Bravo Real Housewives 卡司共享身体→确诊 schizophrenia）；Dee（Tampa——反复噩梦与 Twilight Zone 经典集诡异相似）；Lester（Queens——能复述 General Hospital 五十年全史却一集没看过）；Mary（Decatur——常滑入旧 SNL 小品台词、家人吓到请驱魔人）——Erin 每次落网夜间信号：「I saw them on Pink Eye TV. I think this might be the person who can help.」+新名字地址=「an interdimensional scavenger hunt that they were both participating in.」

流水线：候选多为 loners/outcasts→很 online；私信+自费飞去（富粉丝资助）；welcome guide PDF 首句「You probably won't believe me yet, but you might have created your favorite TV show.」；坦诚问答、坚称不施压；告别礼=Erin 年鉴照+背面手写（同句）——听闻失踪「a little sick」；未跟进的名字也总等来 Google Alert 失踪新闻——自我豁免：「They were leaving his world either way. He might as well arm them with information.」；愧疚自审：「was this obsessive quest just an excuse? A way to stave off hopelessness? …someday Erin might return and everything would finally make sense, like a long-belated but deeply satisfying series finale?」——「Without PAA, what would the rest of David's life even look like?」

AV 地牢回归：毕业三年后银行遇 Walsh 热络（「not the same without you guys—stop by」）；Gerald 一伙与新 Auxiliaries=角色换人（Kailee=新 Leslie/Irwin=新 Ralph/Gerald=新 David——「like a Degrassi reboot where only a few of the original cast returned」）；Gerald 对 PAA 拥有「proprietary sense of ownership」、疑潜伏其私坛；新 Auxiliaries 视他为 celebrity；David 想当 mentee——幻想终局（「救回 Erin、定居 Hartsdale、Walsh 退休时移交 AV Club 钥匙——keep the Auxiliaries going for many seasons and reboots to come」）
facts.anchor: the actors had switched but the roles had stayed the same.

facts.fact: 绝交戏：六周后停车场 Walsh 逐客（parents+teachers 投诉；「Gerald and the other kids—they're coming home talking about alternate dimensions and missing girls. Phantom video stores. They're not…going to parties and getting drunk and doing normal teenager stuff. They're staying up all night watching static on TV. It's not healthy.」）——David 自辩（tapes/broadcasts/「She's calling to us for help」）——Walsh 终于也说穿（「really, she didn't believe him either」）：「But David, Erin is dead.」——「It's creepy. You're being creepy.」——「I've got a job. And a family. Two kids at home and a mother in assisted living who only remembers my name on good days. I don't have time to be your therapist on top of all that. But please hear me when I tell you that you need one.」

纪录片与潜逃：HBO 首部 true crime doc 上线（Erin/Chloe 等家属愤怒访谈）——viral sensation、public outcry；Twitter 整冬 trend；FBI 传闻——开春律师警告 imminent arrest——提前部署：私坛通知「it was time」、打包衣服与 VHS、翻窗出走（「didn't bother saying goodbye to his parents. They'd given up on him a long time ago.」）——几天后抵达沙漠
